streams.name: Know your traffic lights
streams.title: Know your traffic lights
streams.description:
🚦 Quality Traffic Lights
🟢 Green: best link, use first
🟠 Orange: okay, solid backup
🔴 Red: avoid, or last resort only. This only applies to the Tailliuir Network addon.

streams.name: Check TorBox status if something's off
streams.title: Check TorBox status if something's off
streams.description: Before assuming it's broken, check status.torbox.app — most issues are a TorBox outage or maintenance window, not your setup.
